'''Tookra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] who, in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], resided in the [[Kishpaugh spaceport]] of the [[Nelvana Gas Cluster/Legends|Nelvana Gas Cluster]]. He hired [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to deliver him a shipment of parts, but Solo turned up eight months later than arranged. Intending to make Solo pay, Tookra ordered [[K1l-R]], his personal bodyguard [[Droid/Legends|droid]], to attack the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], who, however, escaped. Tookra ordered K1l-R to follow Solo's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and tracked him to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cataalda]]. The droid attacked Solo again, and both Solo and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] failed to stop him with what limited weapons they had, so they stole Tookra's own speeder and tried to escape. Tookra and K1l-R followed them and came across the starship of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dust (bounty hunter)|Dust]]. K1l-R destroyed the starship trying to get to Solo, but that angered Dust, and in an act of revenge he destroyed the droid, to the great grief of Tookra.
